boundary: Existing outcome-first draft construction and its exact authority are being verified. Live browser uses one ordinary pre-Project session and three retained draft revisions, with no model invocation or accepted Project creation against inspection data. Isolated PostgreSQL proves real creation/atomicity and rejection. This does not close definition composition, intake model functions, native examiner execution or overall A1.

review.perspective: Challenge normal drafting with a nonexistent registered example, a forged but recomputed content hash, invented assumption codes, overlapping command identities and whitespace outcomes. Actual production rejection codes must identify the intended authority guard; any generic schema or environment error fails the criterion.
